description: The chart illustrates the performance of various language models across three categories: Understanding, Reasoning, and Trustworthiness. The vertical axis lists 16 different models, while the horizontal axis represents the percentage score, ranging from 0% to 100% in increments of 20%, with each category having its own scale. The chart is divided into three sections, each representing one of the categories, with bars colored in different shades of blue to distinguish between the models. The Understanding category shows scores ranging from 2.4% for Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct to 98.0% for gpt-4o-2024-11-20, with the bars sorted in descending order. The Reasoning category displays scores between 7.2% for Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct and 66.5% for gpt-4o-2024-11-20, also sorted in descending order based on the Understanding scores. The Trustworthiness category has scores ranging from 0.0% for Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct to 88.8% for gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18, maintaining the same order as the other two categories. The bars within each category are not grouped or stacked, and there is no visual emphasis on specific bars. The chart provides a clear comparison of the models' performance across the three categories, with the models listed in the same order throughout.
